podcast.body: A glam pop song written by Moroder on synthesizer, which became a UK number one hit when covered by the British rock band Chicory Tip. Their version featured a "fat-bottomed Moog synthesizer" and even charted on the American Hot 100 in the winter of 1972. "Son of my father, a glam pop song Moroder wrote on synthesizer, was covered by British rock band Chikari Tip."
